# Environment variables

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/render_settings_reference.py from
openmed/core/settings.schema.json. Do not edit by hand: change the schema, then
run `python scripts/docs/render_settings_reference.py`. -->

This page lists every environment variable declared in
`openmed/core/settings.schema.json`, grouped by schema section. It is generated
from the schema, and the docs tests fail when the two drift apart.

Each row gives the type of the parsed value, the default that applies when the
variable is unset, its bounds, whether it holds a secret, and the module that
owns it. Notes on reading the table:

- **Secret** settings never show a default. Prefer the matching `*_FILE`
  setting, which names a mounted secret file, where one is listed.
- **unset** means the variable has no value by default and the owning module
  falls back to the behavior described in the row.
- **comma-separated** values are lists such as `a,b,c`; **JSON** values are a
  JSON document; **byte size** values accept a byte count or a size such as
  `512MiB`; **duration** values accept seconds or a duration such as `5m`.

The declarations come from `openmed.core.settings_registry`, which never reads
the environment. See [Configuration & Validation](../configuration.md) for how
`OpenMedConfig` is loaded and
[Configuration Precedence Audit](precedence-audit.md) for value-free provenance
reports.

Library settings that map onto OpenMedConfig fields declared in config.schema.json.

| `OPENMED_BNB_4BIT_USE_DOUBLE_QUANT` | Whether bitsandbytes 4-bit double quantization is enabled. | boolean | `true` | - | no | `openmed.core.config` |

| `OPENMED_SERVICE_RATE_LIMIT_BURST` | Token-bucket burst capacity; 0 disables rate limiting. | integer | `0` | minimum 0 | no | `openmed.service.runtime` |

| `OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_BODY_GRACE_SECONDS` | Seconds before the minimum body transfer rate applies. | number | `10.0` | above 0; maximum 3600 | no | `openmed.service.request_limits` |
| `OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_BODY_MIN_BYTES_PER_SECOND` | Minimum request body transfer rate once the grace period is spent. | integer | `1024` | minimum 0; maximum 1,073,741,824 | no | `openmed.service.request_limits` |
| `OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_BODY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Seconds allowed to receive a whole request body. | number | `60.0` | above 0; maximum 3600 | no | `openmed.service.request_limits` |
| `OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_SIGNING_MAX_SKEW_SECONDS` | Largest accepted request-signature clock skew in seconds. | integer | `300` | minimum 1 | no | `openmed.service.request_signing` |
| `OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_SIGNING_NONCE_CACHE_SIZE` | Nonces remembered for request-signature replay protection. | integer | `10000` | minimum 1 | no | `openmed.service.request_signing` |
| `OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_SIGNING_ROUTES` | Comma-separated 'METHOD /template' routes that require an HMAC request signature. | list (comma-separated) | empty | - | no | `openmed.service.request_signing` |

| `OPENMED_SERVICE_RETRY_BACKOFF_JITTER_SECONDS` | Random jitter added to each retry backoff, in seconds. | number | `0.01` | minimum 0 | no | `openmed.service.runtime` |
| `OPENMED_SERVICE_RETRY_BACKOFF_MAX_SECONDS` | Largest retry backoff in seconds. | number | `1.0` | minimum 0 | no | `openmed.service.runtime` |
| `OPENMED_SERVICE_RETRY_BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER` | Exponential retry backoff multiplier. | number | `2.0` | minimum 1 | no | `openmed.service.runtime` |
| `OPENMED_SERVICE_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | Attempts per model call, including the first. | integer | `3` | minimum 1 | no | `openmed.service.runtime` |
| `OPENMED_SERVICE_SECURITY_PROFILE` | Service security profile. Default: unset follows `OPENMED_PROFILE`: dev, test and fast select dev; anything else selects prod. | string | `prod` | one of `dev`, `prod` | no | `openmed.service.security_profile` |
